note: licence gate policy, read by scripts/supply-chain/licences.py and explained in docs/security/supply-chain.md section 7. 'shipped' defines what ends up in a released artifact; every package it reaches must carry an osi approved licence, with no exceptions. 'not_shipped_allowlist' lists dev, test, example and tooling packages with a non-osi licence, each reviewed for one exact version and licence, with the reason it is accepted.

apps/console.artifact: the console bundle (deploy/images/console.Dockerfile). the gate also checks every package of the real bundle (apps/console/scripts/bundle-packages.mjs) against this section.

also_bundled.tailwindcss: src/index.css imports tailwindcss, whose preflight and utilities are compiled into the bundled css although it is a devDependency

files_only.shadcn: src/index.css imports only shadcn/tailwind.css, a plain css file with no imports. shadcn itself counts as shipped; the dependencies of its cli (browserslist, caniuse-lite and others) are not bundled and are listed as not shipped

bundle_only.@creit.tech/stellar-wallets-kit: the console imports the kit's module api and a fixed list of its wallet modules (apps/console/src/lib/stellar-wallet/modules.ts), never its walletconnect, hot, near, trezor or xbull connectors. the kit counts as shipped; each package below it counts as shipped exactly when the real console bundle (apps/console/scripts/bundle-packages.mjs) contains it, and the rest of its tree is recorded as not shipped

apps/site.artifact: the public website bundle, shipped in the console image at /srv/site (deploy/images/console.Dockerfile)

also_bundled.tailwindcss: src/index.css imports tailwindcss, whose preflight and utilities are compiled into the bundled css although it is a devDependency

packages/tracker.artifact: sdk.js and the npm package. both builds refuse any input outside src/ and releases/ (ownInputsOnly in packages/tracker/build.mjs), and the packed package.json declares no dependencies

go.artifact: gateway, controlplane, replayer, metricswriter, jobs, platformctl, prober, sloreport binaries
collector image (ocb distribution generated from collector/builder-config.yaml)
